name: triceps press (high bar position)
description: Lying or seated barbell press where the bar travels from a high position over the head, isolating the triceps through a long range.
instructions: Set up with a barbell held at arm's length above your head, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Keep your elbows from flaring out.
Extend your arms to press the bar back to the start.
